description: Unresolved January evidence includes: a 12 January court-side crowd calling for Minister Sawmynaden’s resignation has no count; a 31 January La Louise civic/legal crowd is described as large in opened Defimedia coverage; an L’Express search excerpt estimates about 10,000, but the page could not be opened and the original Defi Media page’s displayed 2026 versus search-indexed 2021 date remains unresolved; a 9 January L’Express search excerpt says hundreds demanded Sawmynaden’s resignation on 7 January; ION News also mentions bystanders near court, but both pages failed open and local DNS blocked ordinary retrieval; LALIT separately alleges that a subgroup attacked the minister’s car, without independent corroboration; Freedom House separately mentions unspecified Wakashio-related protesters being blocked. If a primary or contemporaneous source surfaces, determine whether the Fakhoo claim refers to the already documented 12 January supporter group or to a distinct action; do not infer an event on 20 January.
